actions.name: move_absolute

actions.name: halt_motion

actions.name: switch_off_spine

actions.name: switch_on_spine

actions.name: publish_velocity
actions.description: Publish one geometry_msgs/Twist to the upstream /cmd_vel subscription; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping

actions.name: stand_up
actions.description: Call /Spot/stand_up and require the 'standing up' answer; the callback returns after starting a one-second joint-target transition, so the answer is not completion

actions.name: sit_down
actions.description: Call /Spot/sit_down and require the 'sitting down' answer; the callback returns after starting a one-second joint-target transition, so the answer is not completion

actions.name: lie_down
actions.description: Fixed /Spot/lie_down call with override=true; it sets fixed_motion and starts the fixed lie targets. It acknowledges the start only. The sensed stop sends this request and confirms on odometry; this command alone is not that stop

actions.name: set_height
actions.description: Call /Spot/set_height with a body height offset in the source range; the callback stores zd = -height and returns an empty answer on success

actions.name: publish_actuator_cmds
actions.description: Publish one communication/msg/ActuatorCmds message on /simulation/actuators_cmds with the 12 actuator names fixed in MJCF order. The node applies the PD expression and clamps each resulting ctrl to [-100, 100]; a publication receipt is transmission only, not motion.

actions.name: reset_simulation
actions.description: Call the acknowledged /simulation/sim_reset service with the fixed frame_id spot, an optional base pose and optional 12 hinge positions. The callback calls mj_resetData, zeroes cached commands and returns is_success; it does not pause the physics loop.

actions.name: reset_safe_state
actions.description: Reset simulated data to the model defaults plus the fixed base pose with the acknowledged /simulation/sim_reset service. The callback calls mj_resetData and zeroes every cached actuator command; the MuJoCo physics loop keeps running.

packages.name: Multi-robot TurtleBot3 Gazebo/Nav stack
packages.model: TurtleBot3 Burger tb3_0 and tb3_1 in Gazebo 11
packages.intro: Multi-robot TurtleBot3 Gazebo/Nav stack, adapted from mortezaaliyari/multi-robot-gazebo-navistack. It reads `read_tb3_0_odom`, `read_tb3_0_scan`, `read_tb3_1_odom` and `read_tb3_1_scan`; runs `publish_tb30_cmd_vel`, `publish_tb31_cmd_vel` and `resume_simulation`. `publish_tb30_cmd_vel`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint to the tb3_0 Gazebo cmd_vel topic; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.

actions.name: publish_tb30_cmd_vel
actions.description: Publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint to the tb3_0 Gazebo cmd_vel topic; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping

actions.name: publish_tb31_cmd_vel
actions.description: Publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint to the tb3_1 Gazebo cmd_vel topic; the receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping

actions.name: resume_simulation
actions.description: The declared re-enable after a safety reset: publish a zero Twist on /tb3_0/cmd_vel and /tb3_1/cmd_vel, then unpause the Gazebo world with /gazebo/unpause_physics. Each differential-drive plugin keeps the last cmd_vel it stored and applies it as soon as the world runs; the zeros replace them, but they are unacknowledged publications, so a stored command can still act for a few world steps, and a running move_base publishes new ones.

packages.name: sjtu_drone Gazebo quadrotor simulation
packages.intro: sjtu_drone Gazebo quadrotor simulation, adapted from novog93/sjtu_drone. It reads `read_last_cmd_vel`, `read_state`, `read_pose` and `read_mode`; runs `takeoff`, `land`, `reset`, `publish_cmd_vel` and 3 more. `takeoff`: publish one std_msgs/Empty on /simple_drone/takeoff. The callback only moves the state machine from LANDED_MODEL to TAKINGOFF_MODEL; the receipt proves the publication, not that the simulated drone left the ground. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.

actions.name: takeoff
actions.description: Publish one std_msgs/Empty on /simple_drone/takeoff. The callback only moves the state machine from LANDED_MODEL to TAKINGOFF_MODEL; the receipt proves the publication, not that the simulated drone left the ground.

actions.name: land
actions.description: Publish one std_msgs/Empty on /simple_drone/land. The callback only moves the state machine to LANDING_MODEL; the receipt proves the publication, not that the simulated drone landed.

actions.name: reset
actions.description: Publish one std_msgs/Empty on /simple_drone/reset. The plugin's callback resets the attitude and velocity PID controllers and the current force and torque but keeps the flight state and stored cmd_vel; it is not an acknowledged stop or an operator safety reset.

actions.name: publish_cmd_vel
actions.description: Publish one geometry_msgs/Twist on /simple_drone/cmd_vel. The fields are position targets in position-control mode and velocity/tilt/rate otherwise; the receipt is a publication acknowledgement only.

actions.name: set_position_control
actions.description: Publish one std_msgs/Bool on /simple_drone/posctrl. The callback only stores the flag; the receipt proves the publication, not the resulting control mode.

actions.name: set_velocity_mode
actions.description: Publish one std_msgs/Bool on /simple_drone/dronevel_mode. The callback stores the flag and publishes the resulting cmd_mode String; the receipt proves the publication only.

actions.name: reset_world
actions.description: Call the /reset_world std_srvs/Empty service (gazebo_ros) that the clone's reset_sim.sh uses. It resets the simulated world, but the plugin keeps its flight state and stored cmd_vel, so a flying drone keeps flying; it is not a stop.

It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.

actions.name: step
actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

actions.name: reset
actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

actions.name: seed
actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

actions.name: pause_physics

actions.name: start_game

actions.name: command_turret

actions.name: command_base_velocity
actions.description: Publish one body twist on /jackal0/cmd_vel; the mecanum controller applies its own velocity and acceleration limits and has no execution acknowledgement
